verdict.rationale: llama.cpp loads models from the command line (`llama cli -hf ...`, `llama serve -hf ...`) and documents CPU+GPU hybrid inference that partially offloads models larger than VRAM. Community reports confirm GPU/CPU model splitting and a configurable GPU-layer count, though the N_GPU_LAYERS mention comes via Python wrappers rather than the CLI itself. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a CLI flag for GPU layer offload, any evidence of a command-line context-length setting.
